Post.title: Blog Post
Post.description: Main post document containing meta information like likes.

likesCount.description: Number of likes for the post.

Comment.title: Post Comment
Comment.description: A comment left by a visitor on a post.

authorName.description: The name provided by the visitor.

content.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the comment was posted.

Message.title: Direct Message
Message.description: A direct message sent from the contact form.

posts/{postId}.description: The root post document interaction node.

posts/{postId}/comments.description: A subcollection of broadcasts for a specific post.
